status: No actual source acquisition; official documentation checked selectively; live endpoints untested

n50.coverage: Norwegian mainland and territorial sea; both NO pilots
n50.vintage: weekly distribution; record exact extract date
n50.access: Intersect all municipalities with buffered pilot; municipality extracts only; no national archive
n50.attribution: Kartverket, N50 Kartdata, CC BY 4.0; indicate modifications
n50.limitations: Inspect actual layer schema, inland river polygons and island holes; no extrapolation beyond territorial coverage.

geodanmark.scale: Vector; reported 10 cm urban XY does not establish rural accuracy
geodanmark.vintage: weekly distribution; record actual extract date
geodanmark.crs: ETRS89 UTM 32; DVR90 Z not used
geodanmark.access: Draw buffered AOI, GPKG; authentication changes after scheduled outage 2026-11-26 16:00 to 2026-11-30 08:00; Datafordeler municipal alternative
geodanmark.attribution: GeoDanmark / Klimadatastyrelsen, CC BY 4.0; indicate modifications
geodanmark.limitations: Inspect marine schema before coastal use; strip Z; verify stream polygon vs centreline classes.

elvis.crs: EUREF89 UTM or ETRS89-LAEA Europe; both require Nordic LAEA transformation
elvis.limitations: Optional graph; not shoreline or measured width; hide virtual lines inside water polygons.

topografi50.coverage: Sweden; later expansion, no Swedish pilot
topografi50.access: Geotorget order; confirm bounded tile export and auth; no national download

overture.scale: Variable source accuracy, no uniform RMSE
overture.attribution: Follow full release-specific Overture base attribution and OSM ODbL obligations
overture.access: DuckDB bbox intersection and spatial clipping; no entire theme; public anonymous S3
overture.limitations: Isolated fallback only; land mask subtype=land AND class=land; water physical named features are not surface masks; no automatic merge into permissive national datasets.

eu-hydro.license: Copernicus open access; exact notice pending
eu-hydro.limitations: Legacy comparison, not preferred for pilot, avoid large basin downloads.

excluded.OSMCoastline/Geofabrik: ODbL and oversized archives for bounded pilots; Overture preferred

policy.water: Selected D04 polygon source controls mapped water only inside verified coverage; preserve unresolved areas and coarse fallback separately
policy.lines: Never infer area from centreline; suppress visible line where it intersects water polygon, retain network separately
policy.landcover: WorldCover and CLMS are independent classifications, not authoritative shoreline or surveyed trees; do not treat grassland as pasture
policy.licenses: Separate ODbL processing and outputs; Marker publication held until official layer terms confirmed; no restricted AR5
policy.missing: Unknown remains unknown; valid zero is not missing
policy.storage: D05 10 m uint8 all pilots = 11.25 MiB per band, 30 m = 1.25 MiB; vector transfer and compressed bytes unmeasured
